name: Sylvia Robinson
significance: Founder of Sugar Hill Records; financed and produced the first commercial Hip Hop hits ('Rapper's Delight', 'The Message').[cite: 1]

name: MC Sha-Rock
significance: Lead MC of Funky 4 + 1; pioneered multi-tone vocal projection and dynamic microphone-passing cadences.[cite: 1]

name: The Last Poets
significance: Synthesized radical Black nationalist critique with rhythmic spoken word over West African conga rhythms.[cite: 1]
